title: Telegram
subtitle: Talk to Fi-Sync on Telegram to check your finances and record transactions.

linked.title: Chat linked
linked.description: The bot already recognizes you and answers with your data.

unlinked.title: Not linked yet
unlinked.description: Generate a code and send it to the bot to give it access to your data.

code.title: Link code
code.description: Send this code to the bot within {minutes} minutes:
code.expired: This code has expired. Generate a new one.

steps.title: How to link
steps.one: Open the chat with your bot on Telegram.
steps.two: Generate a link code on this screen.
steps.three: Send the /vincular command followed by the code to the bot.

examples.title: What you can ask
examples.one: How much did I spend this month?
examples.three: How much is my card statement?
examples.five: Sneakers 400 in 4 installments on the card
examples.note: Before recording anything, the bot repeats what it understood and asks you to confirm.

disconnect.title: Unlink Telegram?
disconnect.description: The bot stops answering with your data and the chat history is deleted. You can link it again whenever you want.
